comment: Whether the module runs in stereo is decided by an output cable, not an input one: Tape.cpp:514 sets stereo from outputs[RIGHT_OUTPUT].isConnected(), and with that jack empty the two inputs are averaged at :518 and one tape channel is used for both. The right input is normalled from the left at :513. Print-through is dead in this build: storePrint still fills its buffer but getPrintEcho at :65 returns zero, and tickDrift is never called, so eqDrift stays at 1. The panel carries no lettering on any control; the artwork is a PNG drawn over the SVG and prints only the module's name. The library screenshot for this plugin shows a later Tape with eleven CV jacks that the installed 2.0.0 build does not have.
